submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily as the Fe fraction increased: 0.00005% at Sb 0.51, 0.099% at 0.30, 0.57% at 0.22 and 1.02% at 0.16. The Sb-rich side (0.0041% at Sb 0.71) was close to zero. The most Fe-rich composition on the line (index 0, Sb 0.161) gave the highest measured EQE. This fits hematite-like Fe-rich phases absorbing 2.7 eV light better than the FeSbO4 rutile phase near 50% Sb.
